description: Zero‑dependency, type‑safe Node.js framework that gives Express‑style simplicity with AI‑first hooks, edge‑runtime speed, and native serverless deployment.

download_hooks: Developers pick yantravese because it delivers Express‑level ergonomics **and** out‑of‑the‑box AI/LLM capabilities—no extra packages needed.
